product_one_liner.value: AmplifAI helps enterprise contact centers and BPOs unify customer-interaction data and improve performance through AI-powered quality assurance, coaching, analytics, and performance management.
product_one_liner.notes: The platform overview describes unified interaction data, role-specific AI recommendations, automated QA, coaching, analytics, and performance management for enterprise contact centers and global BPOs.

pricing_page.notes: The reviewed homepage offers a demo rather than a pricing link, and the pricing path returned only a redirect response without public plans or pricing. This is an absence-based finding.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company product page's enterprise customer logo wall names Cox Communications, GoDaddy, and The Home Depot. | named_customers.0: Cox Communications appears in the company's enterprise customer logo wall. | named_customers.1: GoDaddy appears in the company's enterprise customer logo wall. | named_customers.2: The Home Depot appears in the company's enterprise customer logo wall.

employee_band.notes: The reported employee count is 168, which falls within 101–200. Headcount is based on company-profile data rather than a dated company headcount announcement.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company's about page explicitly labels its Plano address as headquarters. | hq_country: The company profile identifies AmplifAI's location as Plano, United States.

founded_year.notes: The company-hosted article dated August 2017 explicitly says Sean Minter founded AmplifAI in 2016. This contemporaneous account is preferred over inconsistent founding years in later descriptions.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains buyer's guides, coaching and CX content, product news, and press categories. Review did not identify the required two engineer-authored posts explaining how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation, help, or developer portal link was found in the reviewed homepage navigation. The public learning material consists of product overviews, tours, and CX thought leadership rather than a product help center or developer documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current careers page lists only Senior .Net Full Stack Developer – Plano, with no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science job title.

model_provider.notes: The security page names internally hosted LLaMA, while the platform solution guide names GPT-OSS 120b as a model AmplifAI hosts itself. These disclosures may describe different deployments or generations of the platform.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: AmplifAI explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certification and self-compliance with HIPAA, PCI DSS, and GDPR. These are public claims, not independent verification of certification. | compliance_certs.0: The page explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II certification. | compliance_certs.1: The page explicitly claims ISO 27001 certification. | compliance_certs.2: The page explicitly claims HIPAA self-compliance. | compliance_certs.3: The page explicitly claims GDPR self-compliance. | compliance_certs.4: The page explicitly claims PCI DSS self-compliance.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The announcement identifies Series B financing, corroborated as the latest round in the funding profile. The financing also includes a credit facility. | funding_date: The company announcement and funding profile agree on September 23, 2025, yielding 2025-09. | funding_amount_usd: The announcement reports $33.7 million in Series B funding and a credit facility combined. The value is the announced financing package, not an independently disclosed equity-only amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 2025 financing announcement falls within eighteen months before November 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live company-hosted SDR posting says it is hiring and provides an application email link. Confidence is reduced because the role is not listed on the newer careers index.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest launch-like announcement identified concerns the TTEC Perform expansion dated April 28, 2026, before the six-month window. The newer award coverage does not announce a product launch. The conclusion is based on the readable announcement history.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Leslie Goodwin's dated profile places her AmplifAI senior-VP work in 2026, within the twelve-month window. The profile's precise role-start chronology is ambiguous, reducing confidence in the exact appointment timing.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The integrations page explicitly describes connections to these four CRM systems. This establishes visible integration signals, not necessarily AmplifAI's own internal sales stack. | crm_stack_signal.0: The integration description names Salesforce cases, contacts, and activity history. | crm_stack_signal.1: The integration description names HubSpot tickets, deals, and contact timelines. | crm_stack_signal.2: The integration description explicitly names Microsoft Dynamics 365. | crm_stack_signal.3: The integration description explicitly names Zoho CRM.
